newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of major Japanese brokers drop to year lows.
newsitem.headline: Shares of major Japanese brokers drop to year lows.

text.p: Shares in Japan's "Big Four" securities houses dropped to their lowest levels for this year on Tuesday morning.
As of 0104 GMT, the share price of Nikko Securities Co Ltd 8603 T was down 38 yen at 863 yen. Volume was heavy at 1.04 million shares.

Daiwa Securities Co Ltd was down 40 yen at 1,030 yen, after briefly dipping to 1,020. Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd 8602 T was down seven yen at 503 yen. It briefly fell to 497 yen. Nomura Securities Co Ltd was down 10 yen at 1,770, after briefly dipping to 1,750 yen.
